dct_description_sm:
This spatial data identifies the locations of areas designated for the study, conservation and improvement of tree species. It includes the location, name and established date for sites. It also identifies the primary or target tree species associated with the site.

In combination with other silvicultural activities such as site preparation and fertilization, these areas support the overall yield, quality and sustainability of products from forest lands.

They also contribute to the study and management of adaptive variation and genetic diversity.
